description: Add a test result to a specific test run via BrowserStack Test Management API. Requires a project identifier (PR-*). No tool here lists projects, so if you do not have one, call askBrowserStackAI with product "tm" and ask which projects exist, then retry this tool with the identifier it returns.

test_case_id.description: Identifier of the test case, e.g., 'TC-13'.

description.description: Optional description of the test result.

status.description: Status of the test result, e.g., 'passed', 'failed'.

test_run_id.description: Identifier of the test run (e.g., TR-678)

name: addTestResult
